title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
script:
Apate is sending AI agents undercover to get scammed on purpose.
Most companies use AI agents to ship products faster or speed up workflows.
Apate takes a different approach by sending them to gather fraud intelligence.
The agents interact with malicious actors to map out modern scam tactics.
This collected intelligence helps build better defenses against financial crimes.
Would you let an AI handle a scammer for you?
